support.title: Help & Support
support.desc: We are here to help you with any questions about the system, your cards, payments or sessions.
support.chatDesc: Reach out to our support team for live assistance.
support.faq1Title: How do I top up my card?
support.faq1Desc: You can top up your card at the canteen counter or through an approved operator during a session.
support.faq2Title: What should I do if my card is lost or damaged?
support.faq2Desc: Report your lost or damaged card to the school administration so it can be blocked and replaced.
support.faq3Title: How do I check my transactions?
support.faq3Desc: Transactions can be viewed from the Transactions section of your dashboard at any time.
